<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
Force pandas mapper to not convert strings 'low' 'high' 'close' and 'open' to symbol before indexing dataframe. Now those keywords are reserved and won't attempt to be converted.

#### Related Issue
<!--- This project only accepts pull requests related to open issues -->
<!--- If suggesting a new feature or change, please discuss it in an issue first -->
<!--- If fixing a bug, there should be an issue describing it with steps to reproduce -->
<!--- Please link to the issue here: -->
Closes #4886 

#### Motivation and Context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
Pandas bug specific to stock ticker LOW, when requesting history for LOW and attempting to access history `.low` values pandas would convert the request for `.low` to symbol LOW which pandas dataframe does not have a value for thus causing the issue.

I reserved more than just low since it is possible that other tickers may fit some of those column names in the future.

<!--- Please indicate if these changes will require updates to documentation, and if so, specify what changes are required -->
N/A

- Confirmed original behavior DataFrame.loc["LOW"] can return a dataframe just for LOW ticker
- Confirmed DataFrame.low is now working

issue_context.title: Add Reserved Names in Pandas Converter
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Be access `low` column in pandas Dataframe with
```python
history = self.History(symbol, 1, Resolution.Minute).low
```
#### Actual Behavior
The statement above raises the following exception:
```AttributeError : 'DataFrame' object has no attribute 'LOW R735QTJ8XC9X'```

#### Potential Solution
Add reserved names in `PandasConverter` to not convert "low" into "LOW R735QTJ8XC9X". We will need to use "LOW" instead.

#### Reproducing the Problem
```python
class NadionDynamicChamber(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2020, 1, 6)
        symbol = self.AddEquity('LOW').Symbol
        history = self.History(symbol, 1, Resolution.Minute)
        self.Quit(history.low)
```
